free_tier.stated: The vendor's own notice, published 2026-10-13, quoted: 'we will be winding down Ona Cloud on October 31, 2026. Please save any code and data you want to keep before then. Current subscribers will be receiving an email with more detail. New signups have already closed.' The company joined OpenAI and points users to Codex Cloud.

retention.stated: The product ends on a printed date nine days after this read and new signups are already closed, so the workspace cannot be entered now and anything held on it has to be exported before 2026-10-31.

chaining: It chains with nothing from this point, and the replacement it names, Codex Cloud, is a ChatGPT-account product rather than a free compute lane.

notes: A workspace product bought by a model lab and closed is the clearest death shape: the notice is first-party, the date is printed, and the reason is an acquisition rather than a cost problem. Anyone who planned a chain on a Gitpod or Ona workspace in October 2026 loses it this month.
